teaser: What the best visual books, Leanpub's Markua, print-on-demand costs and the learning research teach, and what an agent team adds to a printed book.
core_idea: A book made by an agent team should look like it: Markua and print on demand allow more than text and images, limited mostly by the cost of colour; the learning research says words and pictures together, placed together, without decoration, with a cast of concepts first and questions to remember by; the best visual books do this by hand, and an agent team can do it by machine, with every figure a spec that can be rerun, one grammar enforced, animations as filmstrips and every number tied to the register.
